newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean yields end higher on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean yields end higher on tight liquidity.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed higher on Monday due to tight liquidity, caused by the central bank's money absorption last week, brokers said.
Three-month CDs and overnight call rate also edged up in slow trading, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 11.87 pct vs 11.75 pct on Saturday
* 3-mth CDs close at 11.75 pct vs 11.70 pct
* Overnight call rates average 11.40 pct from 11.20 pct
Brokers said the three-year yields, South Korea's benchmark interest rates, would test 12.00 percent on Tuesday.
"Institutions will begin buying bonds at around 12.00 percent in bargain hunting," said a Daishin Securities broker.
Three-month CDs and overnight call rate edged up in slow trading, reflecting tightening liquidity, they said.
